title: Period and Graph of y = -cos(2*pi*x)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the fundamental period of y = -\cos(2\pi x) and describe its key graphical points over one complete cycle.

steps.title: Calculate the Fundamental Period
steps.explanation: Divide 2*pi by the coefficient 2*pi of x to obtain a period of B = 1.
steps.why: An increment of 1 in x changes the argument 2*pi*x by 2*pi.

steps.title: Analyze Amplitude and Reflection
steps.explanation: The amplitude is 1, and the leading minus sign inverts the cosine curve across the x-axis so that it starts at its minimum at x = 0.

steps.title: Locate Quarter-Period Points on [0, 1]
steps.explanation: Dividing the period [0, 1] into quarters of length 1/4 gives minima at x = 0 and 1, zeros at x = 1/4 and 3/4, and a maximum of 1 at x = 1/2.
steps.why: Substituting multiples of 1/4 into -cos(2*pi*x) evaluates -cos at 0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, and 2*pi.
